answer: A bond is refunded only after 14 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The trellis counter is kept in yarrow and vault reveals each reset. A hostile operator therefore has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 14 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 360 aliases cost 312 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
